name: Iona Bell
bio: Iona Bell is best known for Lou Lou in Hunger Games, Sunrise on the Reaping (2026) and Myrtle in Fing! (2026). Iona was born in Peterborough, Cambridgeshire. Iona is an English actress, also with Scottish and Irish heritage.

credits.title: Mare
credits.overview: A young equestrian with terminal brain cancer rides her horse for the last time.

credits.title: FING!
credits.overview: Myrtle's parents will do anything to make her happy, even track down a strange creature in a remote jungle. But when a greedy wildlife park owner takes the rare Fing, the family must pull off a daring rescue to save their magical friend.

credits.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
credits.overview: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

credits.title: Frayed
credits.overview: Relentless ambition drives an obsessive young actress to the brink, under the influence of a brilliant yet controversial director

credits.title: Savage Flowers
credits.overview: Set in an infected world where the children are carriers - a young orphan finds sanctuary in a ramshackle foster home but she soon discovers it's not the world outside that she should fear. It's the girls she's inside with.

credits.title: Pulp by Rind
credits.overview: After Roman’s mother survives a life-threatening illness, he must fight to become her one true love again.
